parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the metric store.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The name of the metric store.

Format: consists of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

For information about how to obtain the name of a metric store, see [DescribeHybridMonitorNamespaceList](~~428880~~).

parameters.name: Spec
parameters.description:
The data storage duration. Valid values:

- cms.s1.large: 15 days.
- cms.s1.xlarge: 32 days.
- cms.s1.2xlarge: 63 days.
- cms.s1.3xlarge: 93 days.
- cms.s1.6xlarge: 185 days.
- cms.s1.12xlarge: 376 days.

For the prices of different storage duration specifications, see the **Pricing** section in [Dashboard](~~223532~~).
